messages.text:
Your bedsheet set and pillowcases are recorded as returned, but the wool blanket hasn’t been received back. A full-order refund can’t proceed until all items are received (refund-policy/v1/return).

Would you like to request a refund for just the bedsheet set and pillowcases for now?
Yes, I’d like a refund for the bedsheet set and pillowcases for now. I’ll send the blanket back later.

Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
